evidence: The training set contains 48,362 duplicate user-video rows, which can distort training by causing the model to overfit on heavily repeated interactions.
expected_effect: Applying the inverse_duplicate_frequency operator will downweight these repeated interactions, reducing overfitting to frequent duplicates and improving generalization on the validation set.
hypothesis: Handling duplicate interactions via inverse frequency weighting during the cleaning stage will lead to a better calibrated model and improve validation ranking.
